description_expanded:
This lovely new vacation rental is located in the newest condominium building at Alys Beach, The Whitby. Located on the 4nd Floor, this condo offers a large balcony with beautiful views overlooking the Amphitheatre and the rooftops of Alys Beach. Guests will love the open kitchen with a large center island and a dining table for six. The family room offers ample seating and plenty of natural light. The primary suite contains a king-sized bed with views looking over the town center. The second bedroom also contains a king-sized bed with adjacent bath. Parking for this condominium is in one designated parking space behind the building. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding Whitby 403. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
